Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi  2025:JHHC:38228  IN THE HIGH COURT OF JHARKHAND, RANCHI  A.B.A. No. 7292 of 2025  ----
Niladhaj Bisai @ Neeladhwaj Bishayee, aged about 29 years, S/o Molin Bisai @ Malin Bishayee, R/o village - Belajuri, PO - Hirachuni, PS - MGM, Mango, District - East Singhbhum, Jharkhand ....
Petitioner -- Versus --

1. The State of Jharkhand 2. Kakuli Bisai, W/o Niladhaj Bisai, daughter of Ganesh Chandra Patra, at present residing at village - Buyangdi, PO - Murlal, PS - Shyamsundarpur, District - East Singhbhum, Jharkhand ....
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR DWIVEDI ---

For the Petitioner :- Mr. Soumitra Baroi, Advocate For the State :- Mr. Santosh Kumar Shukla,
Advocate ----
04/19.12.2025 Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the learned counsel appearing for the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Shyamsundarpur P.S. Case No.03 of Niladhaj Bisai @ Neeladhwaj Bishayee vs The State Of Jharkhand on 19 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92332401/
1 2024, for the alleged offences registered under Sections 323, 406, 498A, 120B and 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Ghatshila.

entities.text: Shyamsundarpur P.S. Case No.03 of Niladhaj Bisai @ Neeladhwaj Bishayee vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner happened to be husband of the informant and the petitioner has instituted the petition under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights.
He further submits 2025:JHHC:38228 that there are general and omnibus allegation against all the accused persons and the entire family members have been made accused.
He then submits that the final form has been submitted and the rest have not been sent up for trial only the petitioner has been sent up for trial.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the State submits that the petitioner happened to be husband.

5. Considering that allegations have been made against all the family members, however, other family members have not been sent up for trial and now the charge-sheet has been submitted and in that view of the matter, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned Court within four weeks and the learned Court shall release the petitioner on such terms and conditions or the sureties as the learned Court may deem fit and proper.
(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Dated 19.12.2025 Sangam/
